name: skill-security-reviewer
title_zh: 装前先过安检门的 Agent Skill 审查员
tagline_zh: 它专盯提示注入、代码执行、数据外泄、供应链漏洞——装任何 Skill 前先让它过一遍，像给行李箱过X光。
tagline_en: Scans any agent skill for prompt injection, code execution, data theft, and supply-chain traps—like an X-ray for.
desc_en: Security review and threat analysis for agent skills. Use when reviewing, auditing, or validating skills for security issues including prompt injection, code execution risks, data exfiltration, supply chain vulnerabilities, and policy violations. Triggers on requests to "review a skill", "audit skill security", "check skill for vulnerabilities", "validate skill safety", or any security assessment
why_zh: 不是泛泛的漏洞扫描，而是针对 Agent Skill 的威胁模型逐条核对，连策略违规都算进去。
why_en: Not a generic scanner—it maps each skill against an agent-specific threat model, covering policy violations too, and gives.
limit_zh: 只审 Skill 的代码与描述，不审运行时行为；需要能访问目标仓库的本地环境。
limit_en: Reviews skill code and description only, not runtime behavior; needs local access to the repo; may miss pure-prompt skills; suggests fixes, doesn't.
title_en: Security reviewer that checks agent skills before you.
